notes: The baseline adds only the common measurement wrappers and per-thread getrusage counters to committed production behavior.
Allocation counts are producer-thread only; canonical records are still allocated on the writer.
Fault sampling occurs outside individual operation timing, once before and once after each sample.
after_allocations excludes the subsequent cold-path prefault and rate-window reservation work.
Summary quantiles are medians of the three per-run quantiles, not pooled quantiles.
The shared CPU and background writer can add scheduler and disk-related tails.
The diagnostic allocation-only phase predates the final owned-record writer optimisation as well as the prefault work.
